weekend_race.race_comments: Corey Heim won the inaugural running of the LiUNA! 150 at Lime Rock Park, his 16th victory in the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following cars dropped to the rear of the field under penalty for the reasons indicated: No. 62 (backup truck).
